name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code: a King (Opus) coordinates generic workers, co-workers, and watchmen — each in its own git worktree on its own branch. Workers are interchangeable capacity; King assigns task scope per-dispatch. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts — anything you version in git. /kingdom:update does a Layer-1 project scan (Sonnet Lead + Haiku fan-out) to find gaps between project docs and kingdom logs. Per-task multi-layer task files + 4-step closer artifact pipeline make the work auditable.
